latest.notes:
The segment editor gets the duck and bed-tail sliders.

Duck the bed to — how far the bed dips while the voice reads, in dB. Leave it alone and the bed follows your station's Audio setting, which is what most should do; set it for the one bed that sits too loud or too shy under its particular read.

Bed after the voice — how long the bed carries on once the read finishes. It comes back up to full and fades across that time under whatever follows, instead of being cut the moment the voice stops. Left at 0 it behaves exactly as before, which is what every bed you already have will do.

Both belong to the bed itself, alongside its Talk Over and end cues, so they apply wherever that bed is used and the player reads them straight off it on air — what you set is what you will hear, and Preview Segment plays it the same way, tail and all.
